snippet.title: Live for Speed - The Big Update
snippet.description:
New graphics system with dynamic lighting (day/night), revamped tracks, 1000 Hz physics and timing, multithreading, and much more. More information: https://www.lfs.net/forum/66-Public-Testing-Forum

Video produced and edited by:
Dániel Balla (LFS: MandulAA)

Video clips recorded by:
Dániel Balla (LFS: MandulAA), Martin Kapal (LFS: Flame CZE)

Featuring:
Chris McElroy (LFS: Degats), Dániel Balla (LFS: MandulAA), Jonathan Palmer (LFS: dekojester), Martin Kapal (LFS: Flame CZE), Pete Butcher (LFS: mbutcher)

Music:
Boundless by Ooyy from https://epidemicsound.com courtesy of Sim Broadcasts

Featured vehicle mods:
SWIRL SPORT 06 CUP by Tomsteel: https://www.lfs.net/files/vehmods/2670D3
RB GTR by ivancsx: https://www.lfs.net/files/vehmods/C4CF5C
FORMULA SKIPPY by Kilo46: https://www.lfs.net/files/vehmods/C05BCF
N.400S GT4 by Aleksandr_124rus: https://www.lfs.net/files/vehmods/F1A4EF
ŠKODA 110 L RALLYE by stuchlo: https://www.lfs.net/files/vehmods/F7BE47
RB4-E by Degats
FZ50 V8 SAFETYCAR by Degats: https://www.lfs.net/files/vehmods/39CEEB
PROTOTYPE 2 by kenblock30: https://www.lfs.net/files/vehmods/8A8457
LILLIA-X GTR by ivancsx: https://www.lfs.net/files/vehmods/6C995F
FXO TURBO LIGHTBAR by Degats: https://www.lfs.net/files/vehmods/A4B0F3
FXO SUPERTOURER by Jake_Blasted: https://www.lfs.net/files/vehmods/D06344
MERSOLES COMEGO by Rubbel_31: https://www.lfs.net/files/vehmods/AFA234
FORMULA AMERICAS 2019 by Kilo46: https://www.lfs.net/files/vehmods/C03CA8
